test_title: PYST 8: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Sparrows : Tree
solution:
The logic followed here is : **Species : Habitat**

 
• Sparrows : Tree 

⇒ Habitat of sparrows is trees. 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Cow : Beach → Incorrect

​⇒ Habitat of cow is grassland.

 
• Option - (2) : **Fish : Water → Correct**

​⇒ Fish has aquatic habitat.

 
• Option - (3) : Owl : Night → Incorrect

​⇒ Owl lives in a variety of habitats, including coniferous forest, mountains, deserts and plains.

 
• Option - (4) : Rabbit : Sand → Incorrect

​⇒ Rabbit habitat includes meadows, woods, forest, grasslands, deserts and wetland. 

Hence, **"Fish : Water"** is the correct answer.

84:T82
